In a microwave, melt 3 oz white candy coating. Stir in peanut butter until smooth.
Add sugar, vanilla and cereal. Chill until firm.
Melt chocolate and shortening; dip in chocolate and place on waxed paper. Chill 15 minutes or until firm.
Melt remaining candy coating and drizzle over truffles.
